title: Paired failure taxonomy
label: tab:exp40-failure-taxonomy
caption: Paired failure taxonomy over 5,247 eligible outcomes. Category values are rates in percent; the recovery-minus-side-effect row is a percentage-point difference. N/A denotes a non-applicable count, not zero. Side effects exceed recoveries, so the registered benefit-over-harm criterion is missed. Numerical best/second-best markers are intentionally omitted.
